summary: GIFT Nifty ~60-70 gap-down after Friday late selloff; FIIs dumping banks/auto/FMCG/oil&gas; FMCG worst month since Lehman; range view 23,800 support to 24,500 resistance (rejected 4x).

events.claim: FIIs sold 9.8-9.9% of their holdings in one month; over 25,000 crore of banking stocks sold (Nov 2024)
FMCG index fell more than 10% in October 2024 - worst monthly fall even vs Lehman and COVID periods
~8 lakh cars lying unsold with dealers worth about 80,000 crore (auto slowdown report)
Bitcoin crossed $80,000 after Trump election win (Nov 2024)

lessons: FII selling clusters at 9:15am, 1:30pm and the last hour - trade those windows defensively
Never trust the pre-open print; real selling starts at 9:15 when FIIs sell at any price
quote: As long as Nifty is taking support around 23,800, it's good. Otherwise things are going to be very bad.

summary: Violent session: -150, +300, -200, closed ~flat near 24,000; long-dated call premiums crashed 70-80 (hope fading both ways); HDFC Bank near ATH; FIIs sold 2,300 cr matched by DIIs.

events.claim: Nifty fell to near 24,000 then rebounded 300+ points intraday (11 Nov 2024)
Far-month (Dec 2025) Nifty call premiums fell 70-80 rupees in one session on fading reversal hopes
Reliance fell ~15% from 3,200 to below 2,700 since its 1:1 bonus adjustment (Nov 2024)

lessons: Market is a tug of war between FIIs and DIIs - retail gets killed in the crossfire
When even far-dated premiums crash both sides, participants have lost hope of a trend either way
quote: Domestic institutions buy what FIIs sell - but there is no guarantee they buy the same shares.

summary: Trump-rally US; Bitcoin $67k to $88k; Nifty range 23,900-24,500 for a month; Reliance enters bear territory (-20%); ATH ~26,300 not reclaimable this year; 50% retrace target 25,200-25,300.

events.claim: Bitcoin rose from ~$67,000 to ~$88,000 after the Trump election win (Nov 2024)
Reliance fell >20% from its recent high, entering bear-market territory (Nov 2024)
SBI delivered good results on Friday yet the stock fell - positioning overrides results (Nov 2024)

lessons: Result-day moves depend on prior positioning: good numbers can still fall, bad numbers can rally
A 50% retracement of a fall (26,300 to 23,800) is the realistic best-case rebound, not a new high
quote: Even the worst result, the market can go up, because short sellers might choose to book profits.
leaks: friend did a short straddle (personal anecdote)

summary: Nifty fell ~400 from high, closing exactly at the 5-Aug panic low (~23,840); Britannia -10%, Bajaj Auto -10-12%, Nestle middle-class warning; CPI at 14-month high; FIIs 30-35 session selling streak.

events.claim: Nifty closed on 12 Nov 2024 almost exactly at the 5 Aug 2024 panic low (Japan -10% day), wiping out ~5 months of rally
India CPI inflation hit a 14-month high (speaker states 6.4%) in Nov 2024 print
FIIs sold ~3,500 crore; selling streak reached 30-35 consecutive sessions (Nov 2024)
Monthly SIP inflows crossed 25,000 crore (Oct 2024)

lessons: When a key support breaks, it flips to resistance - and markets get more fragile as they fall
Stocks falling on good results signal positioning damage, not fundamentals
quote: If FIIs sell 5,000 crore and Nifty falls 100 points today, the same selling may cost 200-300 points as markets get fragile.

summary: US profit-books after +6% post-election; GIFT -30/40 threatens swing low; Nifty future premium 80-90 pts is bearish; Hyundai IPO (27,000 cr) 10% below issue price; plan to sell Dec 25,000 CE as portfolio hedge.

events.claim: Hyundai's 27,000-crore IPO (India's largest) traded ~10% below issue price within days; proceeds went mostly to promoters, not expansion (Oct-Nov 2024)
India CPI at 14-month high of ~6.4% (Nov 2024 print)
Nifty futures traded at an unusual 80-90 point premium with ~9 sessions left in the series - a bearish tell

lessons: Promoters exiting via IPO when retail is euphoric is a valuation signal, not a growth story
Mean-reversion and 50% retracement expectations failed this cycle - price correction became time correction
quote: Why should they come out with an IPO when they don't need the money? The smart people exit when retail is crazy.
leaks: planning to sell 25,000 calls - my portfolio hedge

summary: Free fall to the 200-DMA (~23,500); Bank Nifty -2,000 high-to-low; midcap/smallcap -3% capitulation; rate-sensitives crushed on CPI; VIX +5%; warns of 22,000 if 23,500 breaks.

events.claim: Nifty closed exactly at its 200-day moving average (~23,500) on 13 Nov 2024; Bank Nifty fell ~2,000 points intraday high-to-low (~4%)
Nifty Midcap and Smallcap indices each fell ~3% (13 Nov 2024) - capitulation in broader markets
US Fed had cut rates twice in 2024 with a third cut expected in December, while RBI could not cut due to 14-month-high inflation

lessons: As markets fall, the same selling volume causes larger drops - fragility compounds
If a long-term investor: deploy in stages at -10% and -20% from highs, not all at once
quote: Earlier, if FIIs sold 5,000 crore the market fell 100 points; now it falls 200-300. Markets become more fragile as they fall.

summary: GIFT -70/75 after DII 6,150-crore buy could hold only 100 points; Bank Nifty swung -1,200/1,400 intraday; June-4 election rally fully fizzled; Reliance decisively below -20% (bear grip); no technical support until 22,000; 200-DMA history cited.

events.claim: On 13 Nov 2024 FIIs sold ~2,500 crore yet Nifty fell ~400 points; DIIs bought ~6,150 crore and recovered only ~100 points before GIFT Nifty gave it back
Bank Nifty fell more than 1,200-1,400 points intraday high-to-low (~3%) on 13 Nov 2024
By 13-14 Nov 2024 the entire post-election rally had fizzled - Nifty back near its 3 June close; Reliance closed decisively more than 20% below its recent high
In the last 1.5 years only two episodes broke the 200-DMA decisively: COVID (2020) and 2022 (Russia war + US inflation at 9%); otherwise it produces zigzag of 3-4% each side

lessons: Compare DII buying vs actual index recovery to measure real absorption power
When bank weekly expiries end, expiry-day manipulation windows shrink but bank weakness becomes structural
quote: Technically there is no support until 22,000. If 23,500 has to be defended at any cost by the bulls, if not, they clearly lose the game.

summary: Korea +2.5% (Samsung) after Korea+India were world's worst Oct-Nov; Nifty fell 6 straight sessions; shorting-cascade logic (Reliance Capital 3,000→30 example); 200-DMA overshoot warning; range 23,000-24,000 this week.

events.claim: South Korea's market jumped ~2.5% led by Samsung (18 Nov 2024); Korea and India were the two worst-performing markets globally in Oct-Nov 2024
Nifty fell for six consecutive sessions (6-13 Nov 2024), each day breaking the prior day's low
On 15 Nov 2024 only Nifty fell while Nifty Next 50, Midcap, Smallcap closed green; FMCG -1.5% and India VIX up ~4%

lessons: Markets rarely bottom exactly at the 200-DMA - like a braking car, they overshoot before recovering
Friday and Monday tend to be trending days; treat them with extra caution
quote: Don't ever believe the pre-market closing. FIIs decide to sell at 9:15 no matter what the price.
leaks: I will take more short positions (personal)

summary: 7th straight down day; FIIs sold 34 straight sessions; DIIs' 2,500 cr buying useless; TCS -5% intraday; 200-DMA and 23,500 broken decisively; warns against brokerage reports (CLSA).

events.claim: Nifty fell for the 7th consecutive session (18 Nov 2024); FIIs had sold for 34 straight sessions
TCS fell ~5% (about 200 rupees) intraday on 18 Nov 2024 despite a higher open; Infosys dragged from ADR weakness
CLSA published a bullish India report ('all is well') in Nov 2024, which the speaker dismisses as pump-and-dump

lessons: Never trust brokerage reports - they turn bullish at tops and vanish at bottoms
The entire day's index fall can come from just 2-3 heavyweights; always check breadth
quote: If I had listened to economists I would not have made money - same with brokerage reports.

summary: Morning +300 rally died at 2pm on Russia long-range-missile/nuclear headlines: -250 in 30 min; speaker calls it operator-driven (no gold spike, no global reaction); FIIs sold 3,500 cr (35th session); Reliance -25% from high.

events.claim: Nifty fell ~250 points in 30 minutes on 19 Nov 2024 after media reports of Russia-Ukraine long-range missile escalation
Gold did not spike and global markets did not react to the missile headlines - speaker flags operator manipulation via planted panic news
FIIs sold ~3,500 crore on 19 Nov 2024, the 35th straight selling session

lessons: Verify panic headlines against gold and global indices - real geopolitical shocks move them all
Event risk (elections, weekends) suppresses fresh shorting and amplifies reversals
quote: When war breaks out gold should shoot 4-5%. Nothing moved. The last 45 minutes was clearly an operator's game.

summary: GIFT +60-70 after recovering from missile panic; Nvidia results muted; Maharashtra/Jharkhand exit polls due; Gautam Adani charged in US court (bribery/fraud); new SEBI 2% expiry-day margin from Nov 20.

events.claim: Gautam Adani charged in a US court for bribery and fraud (Nov 2024); US jurisdiction applies because money was raised from US investors
SEBI rule from 20 Nov 2024: additional 2% extreme-loss margin on expiry-day option positions and no calendar-spread benefit for intraday
Nvidia results (20 Nov 2024) drew huge US option premium but little stock reaction

lessons: After expiry-day margin rule changes, keep buffer cash - margin shortfalls force exits at the worst moments
Exit polls have been wrong repeatedly; never carry aggressive event positions into them
quote: Don't argue with your broker on margin shortfall - keep buffer cash or you will cut positions at the worst price.

summary: Adani indictment day: Australian investor with Adani exposure fell >20% (transcript 'TQG Partners'), dragging all Adani stocks to 10% lower circuits for ~45 min; SBI/PFC-type lenders hit as collateral damage; Nifty broke 23,350/23,300 then stabilized.

events.claim: Adani Enterprises and Adani Ports hit 10% lower circuits on 21 Nov 2024 after the US indictment; circuits held ~45 minutes
An Australian investment firm with large Adani exposure fell >20% on 21 Nov 2024 (transcript renders the name as 'TQG Partners' - verify actual name)
SBI and power-sector lenders (PFC/REC type) fell as collateral damage on Adani group loan exposure (21 Nov 2024)
FIIs sold ~5,000 crore on 21 Nov 2024

lessons: Hope is the worst enemy in a falling market - hedge with bought options instead of hoping
A single supply-chain/investor link (one fund's exposure) can cascade into index-level damage
quote: Every time I hope the market stabilizes, it falls. Hope is the worst enemy in the market.

summary: Biggest green candle of 2024: Nifty +500 close (~600 intraday) - pure short covering before state-election weekend; FII/DII flows small vs move; call-seller stop-losses fueled the rally; put premiums refused to fall.

events.claim: Nifty logged its biggest single-day gain of 2024 (~500 points close, ~600 intraday) on 22 Nov 2024
FIIs sold only ~1,400 crore and DIIs bought ~1,700 crore - flows too small to explain the move, confirming short covering
Put premiums stayed bid into the rally while call sellers stopped out - classic short-covering signature

lessons: The biggest rallies are short coverings, not fresh buying - check FII/DII magnitudes to tell them apart
Ahead of event weekends, shorts refuse to refresh - that vacuum alone can produce huge up-moves
quote: Nifty has never moved more than 500 points intraday on the higher side - until today.
leaks: interview to YouTube channels in Tamil Nadu

summary: Historic morning: after BJP-led Maharashtra sweep, GIFT +450; Nifty from 23,300 breakout to ~24,300 = 1,000 points in under two sessions; pure short covering (DIIs <2,000 cr Friday); beaten-down stocks to lead.

events.claim: BJP-led alliance won the Maharashtra assembly election decisively (results 23 Nov 2024)
Nifty rallied ~1,000 points in under two sessions from the 23,300 breakout (22-25 Nov 2024)
Friday's rally ran on under 2,000 crore of DII buying - confirming short covering, not fresh money

lessons: Professionals exit before binary events and re-enter after - they give up 5-10 points to avoid disaster gaps
Beaten-down names bounce hardest in short coverings; already-strong names (HDFC Bank) lag
quote: Two people will be happy today: BJP and the bulls.

summary: US record high on Treasury Secretary pick; Monday's 10,000-crore FII buy was mostly MSCI rebalance (HDFC Bank 31,000 cr delivery); ex-MSCI FIIs still sold ~5,000 cr; consolidation view 24,000-24,500 near term, 23,800-25,000 to Dec-end.

events.claim: FIIs net bought ~10,000 crore on 25 Nov 2024, but ~31,000 crore of HDFC Bank delivery was MSCI rebalancing - excluding it, FIIs still sold ~5,000 crore
MSCI carried out a November 2024 rebalance with huge HDFC Bank weight changes
US markets hit record highs on the new Treasury Secretary nomination (late Nov 2024)

lessons: Separate passive rebalance flows from real active buying before reading FII data
After a 1,000-point rally, expect consolidation between the sold-put floor and sold-call ceiling
quote: What they bought in three days was sold on the fourth - the MSCI inflow was a one-half event.

summary: Consolidation with violence: 200+ point intraday swings both days; Nifty long only above 24,270 but closes short; FIIs net buyers + DIIs net sellers twice; global auto hit by Trump tariff threat; 24,800 (50% retrace) is the December target.

events.claim: Trump tariff threats hit auto stocks globally, including European auto indices -2% (25-26 Nov 2024)
FIIs were net buyers while DIIs were net sellers on consecutive days (25-26 Nov 2024) - unusual reversal of the month's pattern
India Q2 FY25 GDP data due 29 Nov 2024 flagged as the next trigger

lessons: Base-building after a crash shows as violent intraday recoveries with FIIs buying and DIIs booking profits
A 50% retracement of the entire fall (26,300→23,300 = 24,800) is the bulls' realistic year-end goal
quote: While falling, markets fall continuously; while rising they cannot - someone always books profit.

summary: US records; China industrial profits -10% is India-positive; RBNZ -50bps; RBI can't cut (14-mo inflation); 24,350 resistance = 24,300 CE + ~50 premium; Bank Nifty expiry-day manipulation window now shorter.

events.claim: China industrial profits fell ~10% (Jan-Oct 2024) - bad China news is rotation-positive for India
New Zealand central bank cut rates by 50 basis points (Nov 2024)
Bajaj Auto fell from ~12,500 to ~9,000 - over 25% from its recent high (Nov 2024)

lessons: A resistance equals the sold-call strike plus its premium - option data predicts the rejection zone
FIIs selling 1.5 lakh crore makes a 5,000-crore buy statistically meaningless
quote: After selling nearly 1.5 lakh crore, what is the big deal if they buy 5,000 crore?

summary: Monthly expiry day: puts sold 24,100-24,000; 24,350 rejected 3 days; HDFC Bank technically strong; Adani rebound 10-15% ('no arrest warrant, monetary penalty only'); Bank of Korea second straight cut; NTPC Green listed well.

events.claim: Bank of Korea cut rates for the second consecutive meeting (Nov 28, 2024)
Adani group stocks rebounded 10-15% on 27-28 Nov 2024; speaker asserts no arrest warrant exists, only monetary penalty risk
NTPC Green listed with a strong premium (27 Nov 2024); Infosys faced US work-visa penalty reports

lessons: Watch the sold-put floor and sold-call ceiling - expiry resolves between them unless stops get hunted
The first session of a new series is frequently a trending day - plan positioning around it
quote: Many people said an arrest warrant was issued. I said clearly: no. The punishment will be monetary only.

summary: Brutal expiry: Nifty -450 high-to-low; autos (M&M EV launch selloff, global auto weakness) and IT (Infosys -3%, TCS -2%) hammered; but midcap/smallcap/advance-decline positive = concentrated heavyweight selling; FIIs sold 11,750 cr - 2024's biggest day.

events.claim: FIIs sold ~11,750 crore on 28 Nov 2024 - the biggest single-day FII cash-market selling of 2024
Nifty fell 450+ points intraday on the November monthly expiry (28 Nov 2024) while Nifty Next 50, Midcap and Smallcap closed green
Infosys fell ~3% and TCS ~2% on expiry day; Infosys down ~10-15% in November alone
Mahindra & Mahindra launched two electric-vehicle variants (27 Nov 2024) and the stock still fell ~3% on 28 Nov

lessons: Index down + breadth green = concentrated heavyweight selling, often positioning-driven, not fundamental
A big expiry-day fall is historically followed by a rebound in the new series' first session
quote: Somebody wanted to bring the Nifty down - beyond the Nifty, everything closed green.

summary: US holiday; Korea -2% (India's twin worst performer); two decision rules in play: post-expiry-crash rebound (+150 expected) and first-session-sets-the-month; M&M denied 7,000-cr emission penalty rumor; GDP due evening.

events.claim: Nifty actual close 29 Nov context ~23,960 vs displayed weighted-average ~23,915 (exchange weighted-average vs last-price gap)
Mahindra & Mahindra denied a newspaper report of a ~7,000-crore emission-norm penalty (29 Nov 2024)
India Q2 FY25 GDP expected roughly 0.2% below the prior year's 6.7% (data due 29 Nov evening)

lessons: Two session rules to know: big expiry-day falls rebound next session; the first session of a series sets the month
Finance put buying by selling farther options - defined-cost hedges survive violent sessions
quote: If today market rallies, there is a quote for the December month; otherwise it is time to have a bearish view.

summary: Both rules delivered: flat open, +300 day; GDP disappointed (~5.5% vs 6.7% y/y) but India is not data-driven; FIIs sold ~17,000 cr in two days; Bharti+Reliance+ICICI = 50% of the rally; December seen volatile and directionless.

events.claim: India Q2 FY25 GDP came at ~5.4-5.5% vs 6.7% a year earlier - a major miss and international headline (29 Nov 2024)
FIIs sold ~12,000 crore Thursday plus ~5,000 crore Friday (28-29 Nov 2024)
Bharti Airtel, Reliance and ICICI Bank contributed ~50% of the day's Nifty rally; Bharti Airtel alone ~50 points

lessons: India is a liquidity-driven market, not a data-driven market - bad GDP barely dents it
Option sellers spread strikes every 500 points in directionless regimes - the market structure reveals itself
quote: If this had happened in the US it would have been a disaster. Here, people don't bother about the economy data.

summary: Surprise rally on bad data: opened flat, fell 150 to 24,008, then +300; DIIs bought 3,600 cr vs FII sales of just 258 cr; put premiums refused to decay (fear bid) keeping VIX high; Reliance 'informed buying'; HDFC Bank recovered 30+.

events.claim: Nifty fell ~150 points to 24,008 then rallied ~300 points (2 Dec 2024) despite weak GDP/inflation data
FIIs sold only ~258 crore while DIIs bought ~3,600 crore (2 Dec 2024)
India VIX stayed elevated as put premiums failed to decay even as the market rallied - sellers afraid of reversal

lessons: VIX stays high not on moves but on fear - when put sellers won't sell, volatility is being priced, not realized
A 30-rupee recovery in HDFC Bank alone lifts Bank Nifty 500-600 points - heavyweight math drives indices
quote: Call premiums shot higher but put premiums would not come down - people are afraid to sell puts.

summary: US/Asia higher despite weak India PMI; technical-long threshold now 24,535; personal 24,700/24,800 CE sold at 12-13 now 25-27 (vol spike); from Jan 1 all NSE expiries on Thursday, BSE on Tuesday; Feb budget expected weak.

events.claim: Exchange consolidation from 1 Jan 2025: all NSE weekly/monthly expiries move to Thursday; BSE Sensex and Bank Expiry to Tuesday
India's November manufacturing PMI came below expectations yet the market rallied (1-2 Dec 2024)
Infosys faced reports of a US work-visa-related penalty (early Dec 2024); ICICI and HDFC Bank ADRs traded lower

lessons: Consolidating expiries to one day per exchange removes manipulators' daily playground
When your indicator misfires (Heikin-Ashi vs normal candles), disclose and correct publicly - credibility compounds
quote: From January 1 everything expires on Thursday in NSE and Tuesday in BSE - less and less expiry games.

summary: Open -100, +200; December already +550 in 3 sessions (>2%); FIIs bought 3,500+ cr while DIIs sold (pattern flip); 24,350 resistance broken after 4-5 rejections; Bank Nifty +1,000 from yesterday's low; admits pre-market chart error.

events.claim: FIIs bought ~3,500 crore while DIIs were net sellers (3 Dec 2024) - first sustained FII buying after the 34-session streak
Nifty broke the 24,350 resistance that had rejected it four to five sessions running (3 Dec 2024)
Bank Nifty rallied ~1,000 points from its prior day low, led by HDFC Bank (3 Dec 2024)

lessons: A resistance hammered repeatedly gets weaker each time - the tin-sheet analogy; fourth break often runs
One day of genuine FII buying against a shorted market produces outsized moves (short-covering amplifier)
quote: The more times you hammer a tin, the more likely it breaks - 24,350 was hammered four times and gave way.

summary: South Korea's brief martial law shakes Asia (revoked same night, KOSPI -2%); Bank Nifty 4% from ATH vs Nifty 8%; HDFC Bank crosses 1,800 multi-year high; ITC hit by GST 28%→35% proposal; RBI policy Friday; range view 24,000-25,000.

events.claim: South Korea's president declared martial law on the evening of 3 Dec 2024 and revoked it within hours after market/currency shock; KOSPI fell ~2%
ITC fell on a government proposal to raise GST from 28% to 35% on aerated drinks and tobacco to offset insurance-GST cuts (Dec 2024)
HDFC Bank crossed 1,800 - a multi-year high (Dec 2024); Bank Nifty within ~4% of its all-time high vs Nifty ~8% below
RBI monetary policy due 6 Dec 2024; banking strength suggests market expects a positive surprise (e.g., CRR adjustment)

lessons: One day of real FII buying lifted the index 1,000 points - direction in this market is decided by who blinks: FIIs, DIIs, retail
Bank-led rallies with Bank Nifty nearer its high than Nifty mark a regime where lenders lead the tape
quote: At the end of the day, it is with whom the retail people stand - that is where the market moves.
